title: Using generative AI to investigate medical imagery models and datasets
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It presents a workflow to investigate visual signals in medical images that are correlated with a model's predictions for tasks related to medical conditions (e.g., cataract presence, low hemoglobin) and demographic factors (e.g., sex, race/ethnicity).
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
